# Project

Builds, for each object in an array, a new object with only the listed fields.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Project(items, fields)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to read. Null is read as an empty array. Elements that are not objects are left out. Any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `fields` | array | An array of the field names to keep, each one key as written: a name with a dot in it is never read as a path. Elements that are not strings are ignored. Null is read as an empty array, which gives empty objects. |

## Returns

Array. A new array with one new object for each object in items, in order, holding each listed field in the order of fields, with null for a field the object does not have. Never null.

## Example

`Project([{ "a": 1, "b": 2 }], ["a", "c"])` returns `[{ "a": 1, "c": null }]`.
